item.title: Crackme drill: three-operand imul
item.description:
Target: Windows x86-64.
# Crackme: find the input (Windows x64, arg in ecx)
``` imul eax, ecx, 13 add eax, 7 cmp eax, 150 sete al movzx eax, al ret ```
Which value of `ecx` makes the function return 1? Give it in decimal.
ANSWER **Answer:** `11` (0xB)
1. `imul eax, ecx, 13` is the three-operand form (opcode 6B /r for imm8): dest = src * immediate, so the source `ecx` is not overwritten. Only the low 32 bits of the product are kept. 2. The check needs `13*ecx + 7 == 150`, so `13*ecx = 143`. 3. Dividing gives `ecx = 11`. Check: 143 + 7 = 150. Since 13 is odd it is invertible mod 2^32, so 11 is the only 32-bit solution.
